basics.name: Candace Fisher
basics.label: Software Engineer
basics.summary:
I am a Software Developer with years of experience in designing, developing, and maintaining a high-performance web application. My expertise includes Ruby on Rails, JavaScript, RESTful APIs, and Python. My experience spans code migration, UI enhancements, automation, production support, and performance optimization. I am also skilled in database management, third-party API integrations, and building scalable, secure solutions. Beyond development, I actively engage in code reviews, agile methodologies, and cross-functional collaboration to drive business value.
I have a solid understanding of  Microsoft Power BI to enhance productivity and analyze data. I am passionate about continuous learning, problem-solving, and crafting software solutions that enhance user experience and operational efficiency. Let's connect to explore how I can contribute to your next project!
